columns.name: Reporting Year
columns.description: The year in which the record was reported, covering bank operations in the previous year.

columns.name: Bank
columns.description: Name of bank submitting data for municipal depository RFP

columns.name: RFP Source
columns.description: RFP submission item data were drawn from.

columns.name: Data Description
columns.description: The specific data that the bank were required to submit.

columns.name: Census Tract
columns.description: The Census Tract of the property whose loan application is described by the record.

columns.name: Action Taken
columns.description: Indicates action taken on the  loan application by bank. See the dataset description for a link to the codes used.

columns.name: Total Units
columns.description: Number of individual dwelling units related to the property secured by the  loan application.

columns.name: Open End Line of Credit
columns.description: Indicate whether loan application is for an open line of credit. See the dataset description for a link to the codes used.

columns.name: Loan Type
columns.description: Wheter the loan or application is insured by the FHA,VA, RSA, or FSA.  See the dataset description for a link to the codes used.

columns.name: Loan Purpose
columns.description: Purpose of  loan application. See the dataset description for a link to the codes used.

columns.name: Loan Amount
columns.description: Amount of loan or amount applied for.

columns.name: Application Date
columns.description: Date of the loan application.

columns.name: Interest Rate
columns.description: Interest rate on the approved application or loan.

columns.name: Loan Term (Months)
columns.description: Number of months after which the legal obligation will mature or terminate.

columns.name: Total Points and Fees
columns.description: Total points and fees charges in connection with the loan.

columns.name: Lien Status
columns.description: Whether the property is a first or subordinate lien. See the dataset description for a link to the codes used.

columns.name: Property Value
columns.description: Value of property relied on that secured the loan.

columns.name: Combined-Loan-value Ratio
columns.description: Ratio of the total amount of debt that is secured by the property to value that was relied on.

columns.name: Purchase Price
columns.description: Purchase price of the property.

columns.name: Down Payment Amount
columns.description: Indicates the down payment amount of the property.
